title: Unbox a taped delivery parcel
instruction: Cut the top seam and both taped end folds, return the cutter, open the plain box flaps, and place the blue item on the green pad.
context: Receiving and unpacking parcels requires tool use followed by opening an enclosure and retrieving its contents.
setup: Plain cardboard carton, 220 x 180 x 75 mm, 3 mm walls, ordinary flaps without handles or pull tabs. A 48 mm tape strip covers the lid seam and wraps 40 mm down both end walls. Guarded cutter and blue item; fixed numeric geometry in task.py.
scoring: 0.25 only after the long seam and both end folds are cut; 0.5 after both flaps reach 80 degrees; 1.0 for released item placement and cutter return with both flaps at least 70 degrees open for one second. All numeric conditions are in README.
run_limit: 3600 control steps at 20 Hz (180 simulated seconds); validated scripted demo completes in 2045 steps.
reset_notes: Fresh process per trial restores closed flaps, uncut tape, item and cutter. Fixed seed 0; object jitter 0.
fidelity: Rigid cardboard with ideal hinges and fixed packing fixture. Tape fracture uses measured held-blade sweep coverage to release a physical hinge latch; adhesive, fracture forces, cardboard flexibility and tool damage are not calibrated. No object teleportation or hand attachment. Development prototype, not validated for real-world fidelity.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 in 3600 actions, zero tape segments cut. Scripted demo and repeat: 1.0 each in 2045 actions. All scores independently replayed and audited on identical setup/runtime.
